rationale: The agent did not follow required steps. There is no authentication of the user before acting. The agent executed a return for a Bluetooth speaker and modified a laptop order without first confirming the specific actions with the user, violating the confirm-before-write policy. The user requested options if no exact 13-inch item was available and expressed preferences; instead, the agent unilaterally selected a 13-inch i5, 1TB SSD, silver model without presenting options or confirming availability. Details like the 1TB SSD appear unsupported by any tool output shown. The conversation also lacks evidence of verifying which speaker matched “more expensive yet not water-resistant.” Overall, multiple policy requirements (authentication, confirmation, accurate supported info) were not met.
